title: Fourier degree bounded by decision tree depth
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $h:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{ -1,1\}$, and let $T$ be a finite binary decision tree whose internal nodes query coordinates from a subset of the $n$ input coordinates and whose leaves return real numbers. Suppose that, on every binary input $x\in\{0,1\}^n$, the tree returns the real value of $h$ at the corresponding sign input, obtained by replacing each bit $0$ by $1$ and each bit $1$ by $-1$. Then the Fourier degree of the real-valued sign function $h$ is at most the depth of $T$.
